description:
**Fixed:** tapping "load more comments" on a row whose comments were removed or deleted no longer shows "Reddit no longer lets rif load these comments" and leaves the row spinning. The row now goes away and rif shows its own "no more comments" toast ([#2](https://github.com/notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes/issues/2)).

Add it in ReVanced Manager as a remote patch bundle:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes/main/bundles/stable.json`

Patch your **original** rif 5.6.22 APK (free or golden platinum) together with the official **Spoof client** patch, and MojiRS's rif patches if you like.
